settings.question: What happens at the session?
settings.answer: A relaxed group chat covering everything above, plus test rides — no pressure, just information and a go on the bikes.

settings.question: How long does it run?
settings.answer: Around 60–90 minutes, plus test ride time. We'll confirm when we book you in.

settings.question: Is it one-on-one or a group session?
settings.answer: Usually a group session for your community, with one-on-one time during the test rides.

settings.question: What happens after?
settings.answer: Entirely up to you. We'll follow up with anything you asked for — a quote, a fitting, or nothing at all.
